justification: Insufficient modularization is present: `javaparser-core/src/main/javacc/java.jj` shows the token manager template bundling several responsibilities in one generated class, including token storage (`tokens`, `homeToken`, `storeTokens`), comment tracking (`commentsCollection`), markdown-comment buffering/parsing (`markdownCommentTokens`, `createMarkdownComment`, `CommonTokenAction`), and lexical feature toggles (`yieldSupported`, `expectMarkdownComment`, `expectEndOfMarkdownLine`). The same grammar file also contains a large token/specification section for whitespace, comments, reserved words, and literals, while `javaparser-core/src/main/javacc-support/com/github/javaparser/GeneratedJavaParserTokenManagerBase.java` only extracts a few comment-conversion helpers, leaving most behavior centralized in the token manager rather than decomposed into smaller cohesive classes.
